name: Country Flags API
freeEvidence: Official Flagpedia API documentation explicitly describes a completely free CDN and documents the country-code/name JSON endpoint. Only JSON metadata is supported here; binary flag images are outside this gateway response contract. Attribute Flagpedia where appropriate.

name: Feodo Tracker API
freeEvidence: Official blocklist documentation provides a JSON feed and explicitly permits all commercial and non-commercial uses under CC0. Read-only feed download; no contact with listed infrastructure. Public dataset is best-effort and can have false positives.

name: ToS;DR API
freeEvidence: Official developer reference documents keyless service GET. Official contribution terms license the open data CC BY-SA 3.0 or later with the stated AGPL larger-program exception. Existing registry labels this public service free. Preserve attribution and share-alike obligations; no paid resale is inferred.

name: Lido Protocol API
freeEvidence: Official Lido integration documentation explicitly invites app/website integration and states APIs are strictly read-only; it publishes this unauthenticated APR endpoint. Existing full registry labels this API free. No wallet, transaction, staking, withdrawals or paid RPC is used.

name: Raydium Protocol API
freeEvidence: Official Raydium REST guide documents anonymous HTTPS access for API v3, recommends this heavily cached read endpoint and permits caching/proxying for high throughput. Existing registry labels this API free; no paid plan, wallet-signed Forum, quote transaction, RPC submission or on-chain action is used. Respect progressive per-IP rate limits.

name: Orca Protocol API
freeEvidence: Official API overview describes the public read API, explicitly says read access requires no authentication and documents size-limited pagination and fair-use rate limits. Existing registry labels this API free. Only public pool metadata is read; no wallet, swap, transaction or paid RPC is used.
